messages:
zoe-cs: Heads-up: Meridian Diagnostics needs a Canada-region allowlist + temporary QPS raise for a privacy/regulatory demo on Tue 10:00-11:30 UTC. Renewal flagged as at-risk if demo lags. can infra help?
lee-sre: sure. are they Hosted or Dedicated? need org id, CIDRs, requested peak qps, and rollback plan.
zoe-cs: Hosted PAYG. org id org-md-221. CIDRs: 207.148.70.0/24, 142.239.32.0/24. requested peak qps = 900 (baseline ~120). window 2026-05-05T10:00:00Z -> 2026-05-05T11:30:00Z. target p95 < 300ms.
ana-platform: we can preference ca-central-1 edge and apply CIDRs to the proxy allowlist. recommend soft cap 1k qps, circuit break 1.2k. will enable prefix cache prewarm for core prompts.
lee-sre: plan: create temp rate-policy + allowlist, soft cap 1000, breaker 1200, pin routing to ca-central-1 for the window. will also enable detailed telemetry. snippet: {org_id:org-md-221,start:2026-05-05T10:00Z,end:2026-05-05T11:30Z,max_qps:1000,cb_qps:1200,allowlist:["207.148.70.0/24","142.239.32.0/24"]}
infra-bot: ticket #CS-9420 created for temp policy + allowlist. assigned to lee-sre. auto-revoke scheduled.
ops-oncall: capacity confirmed in ca-central-1 for that slot. reserving burst nodes and enabling token traces. will watch the session from #release-war-room.
noah-ae: i'll attend the demo and join the renewal meeting. zoe, can you collect their success criteria so we can show metrics?
zoe-cs: yes — they want p95 < 300ms, zero 5xx, and successful SSO flows. i'll share prewarm steps and ask them to rotate keys to ephemeral for the session.
lee-sre: policy pushed -> policy_id=tmp-md-221-20260505. allowlist applied. dashboard: https://console.redwood.example/org/org-md-221/session-20260505
ops-oncall: standing by for the window. posting hourly status updates.
zoe-cs: thanks team — will follow up with post-demo feedback and any logs for the renewal pack.
